steps.user_message: I met my colleague Mark at the cooking class last night, and we had a great time learning new recipes together.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I met my colleague Mark at the cooking class last night, and we had a great time learning new recipes together.
steps.agent_response:
Nice — sounds fun! Would you like me to do anything with that (send or draft an email to Mark, save a note, add him to contacts, etc.)?

Here are three short example messages I can send or draft for you — tell me which one you want and whether to send now or save as a draft, plus Mark’s email if you want me to send:

1) Quick thank-you
Hi Mark — great meeting you at the cooking class last night! I had a lot of fun learning those recipes together. Would you like to try one of them this weekend? —[Your name]

2) Share a recipe
Hi Mark — I enjoyed the class last night. I typed up the recipe for the chicken dish we tried — want me to send it over or swap notes sometime? —[Your name]

3) Invite to meet
Hi Mark — it was great cooking with you last night. Want to grab coffee this week and talk about trying another class together? I’m free [two possible times]. —[Your name]

Which message (or a different one) would you like me to send or save as a draft, and to which email address?
